messages.text: BL-1890 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfix 89935d52d0: test_bl1366_land_is_one_command.sh's killed-land case sent TERM to a subshell instead of the land, so the land ran on holding the lock and the case passed only when the land finished within 2 s; the land is now exec'd. Review also decides whether a TERMed land should stop (its trap releases the lock but does not exit)
